svg.title: I2C timing in Fast-mode Plus
svg.desc: I2C timing of the PCA9685 in Fast-mode Plus: the start condition, the first address bits, the last data bits, the acknowledge and the stop condition, with the bus free, start, clock, setup, valid and stop times of the data sheet.
svg.text: Datasheet: 13 Dynamic characteristics, Table 15, p. 40; 13 Dynamic
characteristics, Figure 32 I2C-bus timing diagram, p. 42.
Bus free time between a STOP and a START condition
Hold time of a (repeated) START condition
LOW period of the SCL clock
HIGH period of the SCL clock
SCL LOW to the acknowledge valid on SDA
SCL LOW to SDA data out valid
Setup time of a STOP condition
Rise time of SDA and SCL
Fall time of SDA and SCL
The bus time-out resets the interface when SDA or SCL stays LOW for
25 ms. Standard-mode and Fast-mode values are in the other columns
